meta.obs_source: ERA5 (Copernicus Climate Change Service) via ARCO-ERA5 (Google Cloud public dataset)
meta.obs_window: day D = ERA5 hourly tp ending D 01:00..D+1 00:00 UTC, same window as lead L hours (24(L-1), 24L] of the 00 UTC run

gefs-reforecast.source: NOAA GEFSv12 reforecast (noaa-gefs-retrospective, AWS NODD), APCP, 00 UTC, 0.25 deg

ifs.source: ECMWF open data (AWS mirror ecmwf-forecasts), tp, 00 UTC run, IFS oper (0.4 deg before 2024-02-29, regridded bilinearly)

aifs.source: ECMWF open data (AWS mirror ecmwf-forecasts), tp, 00 UTC run, AIFS single (dirs aifs/ until 2025-02, aifs-single/ after)
